r=2*i+2;if(l<n){highlight[l]='red';comparisons++;yield;if(data[l]>data[largest])largest=l;highlight[l]=null;}if(r<n){highlight[r]='red';comparisons++;yield;if(data[r]>data[largest])largest=r;highlight[r]=null;}if(largest!=i){[data[i],data[largest]]=[data[largest],data[i]];swaps++;highlight[i]='yellow';highlight[largest]='yellow';yield;highlight[i]=null;highlight[largest]=null;yield* heapify(n,largest);} }function* radixSort(){let max=Math.max(...data);let exp=1;while(Math.floor(max/exp)>0){yield* countingSort(exp);exp*=10;}for(let
